751-4289-5223.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-7297-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

647-3755-4770-5301.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

640-1339-1832-4050.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
640-1339-1832-4050.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1379-1651-4659-5261-8117.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Raise the Alarm without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Raise the Alarm, creating two creature tokens that are also artifacts due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping both creature tokens, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing one creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped tokens, you may sacrifice any number of them to add infinite colorless mana.

1636-4147-4215-6495.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4147-4215-6495.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Evereth by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1636-4147-4215-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

465-3817-6495.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
465-3817-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3534-6495-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
You control seven or more lands with different names.
3534-6495-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3534-6495-7084.notes:
The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2590-5434-5776-7313.description:
Activate another creature you control, which is a Food due to Ygra, by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Ygra and Experimental Confectioner trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Repeat.

2020-4050-4182-7639.description:
Cast Whispers of the Muse by paying {U} due to Vadrik.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

4038-5963-7488.description:
Activate Marvin using Topiary Lecturer's ability by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to Marvin's power.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.
4038-5963-7488.notes: Marvin will make an additional {G} each iteration due to the +1/+1 counter increasing its power.

13-140-3245.description:
Activate Selenia by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

4050-5075-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4050-5075-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Ogre Slumlord and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3941-4067-6281-7206.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
3941-4067-6281-7206.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Dundoolin Weaver.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Dundoolin Weaver that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dundoolin Weaver token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

275-2034-2350-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Stone Calendar.
Repeat.

654-1575-6748.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food
654-1575-6748.description:
Activate a Food by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that is a Food due to Ragost.
When the Treasure enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasure.
Resolve the Food ability from step 1, causing you to gain 3 life.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that is a Food due to Ragost.
When the Treasure enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasure.
Repeat from step 5.
654-1575-6748.notes: If mana allows, you can instead use the Treasure to gain life instead of generate mana.

486-1978-2436.description:
Cause Marwyn to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat from step 2.

2404-5200-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures.
2404-5200-6474.description:
Activate the creature with Sword of the Paruns attached using Gaea's Cradle's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.
2404-5200-6474.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

2988-4740-5760.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 51.
2988-4740-5760.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, targeting yourself, but instead preventing the damage and causing you to gain 51 life due to Purity.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 as desired.

586-4314-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2532-4404-4617-4906.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-4404-4617-4906.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin abilities, adding eight {R} and giving creatures you control trample until end of turn.
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Jaxis' ability, targeting every other creature you control.
Resolve all Jaxis abilities, creating a token that's a copy of each other creature you control with haste.
Put the token Agrus Kos into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Agrus Kos and Corridor Monitor tokens trigger.
Resolve the Agrus Kos trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Jaxis.
Repeat, using the Soulbright Flamekin token instead.

3197-4509-5783.description:
Cast Plumecreed Mentor by paying {1}{W}{U}.
When Plumecreed Mentor enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token with flying and vigilance due to Divine Visitation..
When the Angel enters the battlefield, Plumecreed Mentor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

1020-3689-4647-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken artifact with mana value one or less that can be cast using only colorless mana.
1020-3689-4647-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact with mana value one or less and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, its ability triggers twice, returning Workshop Assistant and the nontoken artifact with mana one or less to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Workshop Assistant and the nontoken artifact by paying at most {4}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the nontoken artifact and Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers twice, returning the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast the nontoken artifact and Myr Retriever by paying at most {3}.
Repeat.

678-2452-2974.description:
Cast Repository Skaab by paying {0}.
When Repository Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Repository Skaab dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1550-2105-4359.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1550-2105-4359.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

3794-4277.description:
During your draw step, activate Well of Knowledge by paying {2}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Cadaverous Bloom by exiling a card from your hand, adding {B}{B} or {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2493-3395-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp to your hand.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Archaeomancer to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
